items.name: Axe of Hurricane
items.appearance: A thick iron black ax with many symbols and magic runes on its surface.
items.function: It can raise agility and has a chance to produce a numbing effect or lightning at every strike depending of the weather.

items.name: Holy Sunbird Whip
items.appearance: A whip that can be disguised as a belt.
items.function:
Purification
Holy Water Creation

items.name: Inevitable Gun
items.function:
1. It will continuously spread disease and decay within a three-kilometer radius, with random types of diseases.
2. It can add either the Certain Death or Sure Hit effect to fired bullets, for a total of thirteen times, which can be stacked with the original Heavy Strike effect.

items.name: Inscribed Steel Sword
items.function: Purifying and Warding

items.name: Meat Cleaver
items.appearance: A meat cleaver with exquisite mechanical structure.
items.function: Transformation

items.name: Whip of Slowness
items.function: Slows the opponent

items.name: Winter is Coming
items.function:
1. The bullets it fires carry a corruption, producing two effects: One, ensures the bullet hits its target; even Saints, unless they use special abilities to dodge, will be hit.
2. Two, ensures death; even Saints, lacking certain traits and abilities, once hit, will suffer great trauma and gradually die. For beings below demigods, a hit means certain death.
3. These two effects cannot coexist; a choice is made for each shot.

items.name: Ancient Silver Mirror
items.appearance: A classic silver mirror with mysterious patterns on the sides.
items.function: Unknown

items.name: Artificial Death Product's White Feathers
items.appearance: White feather stained with yellow oil.
items.function: They can be sacrificed to Artificial Death or wielder of Death Uniqueness to receive a response.

items.name: Authority Holder's Under-the-table Transaction
items.function: It simplifies complex deals by inserting items into a box and stating clear requirements.
items.downside: It has limited uses. Each use increases the risk of encountering evil creatures in future transactions.

items.name: Azik's Copper Whistle
items.function: It can summon one of Azik's messengers.
items.downside: It attracts undeads.

items.name: Beatrice's Necklace
items.function: Corresponds to a total of five desires: lust, appetite, acting, and fulfillment.
items.downside: The wearer will become more excited than usual, and their various desires will significantly increase.

items.name: Black Primordial Demoness Figurine
items.appearance: A pitch-black, palm-sized figurine of a beautiful woman with snake-like hair.
items.function: It is able to suppress non-conscious diseases, shielding the user from them.

items.name: Botis' Traveler's Bag
items.appearance: A black pocket the size of a grown man's palm.
items.function: A hidden space that can store items.

items.name: Bottomless Wine
items.function: Restores stamina and spirituality after drinking it.
items.downside: If it is consumed more than once a day, the user will become a drunkard.

items.name: Cheek's Rings
items.function: It can make the bearer a vessel for the Primordial Demoness' descent.
items.downside: The descent puts a strain on the vessel.

items.name: Circle of Binding
items.function:
1. It can use the Circle Inhabitant effect nine times, each Circle Inhabitant lasting no fewer than three times and no more than nine times.
2. Whether or not the Circle Inhabitant uses are exhausted, this bracelet contaminated by Inevitability powers will enhance the abilities of Fate Appropriation, Fate Exchange, Magnified Fate, and Compelling Fate to the Circle Inhabitant level.
items.downside:
1. Even just carrying this silver bracelet will unknowingly attract Inevitability boon recipients and be viewed with hostility by them.
2. Each use of Circle Inhabitant will result in a period of bad luck, the specifics varying depending on the user's status.

items.name: Corpse Wax Candle
items.appearance: A wax candle encased in a small glass vial with a light yellow and red hue.
items.function: Allows user to form a pact with the City of Calamity.
items.downside: Without the required level or protection, the user will get corrupted and lose control.

items.name: Death Masks
items.appearance: Golden masks streaked with black and white paint.
items.function:
1. Protects the wearer from the corrosion of the aura of death.
2. Transforms the wearer into an undead creature.
items.downside:
1. The purification of sunlight and lightning will be fatal to transformed undead.
2. If a living person wears it for too long, they will truly become deceased.

items.name: Demon Mask
items.function: Seals the thoughts and abilities of the person wearing it

items.name: Endless Cosmos
items.appearance: An oil painting depicting a strange cosmos
items.function: Allows the Inextinguishable Ravings and the Circle of Inevitability to transmit a bit of Their power into the barrier.

items.name: Fallen Mercury
items.appearance: A slivery-black dirk, twice the size of a normal one, covered with strange patterns.
items.function:
When it draws blood from a target, it can exchange one of the target's fate with one it had stored. It cannot injure the target during the process.
If there is no fate stored in it to be exchanged, it has to completely kill the target to take one of his fate.
items.downside: It has the ability to turn most living beings that come into contact with it into its slaves.

items.name: Featureless Doll
items.function: Appearance Morphing, Paper Figurine Subtitutes, Flaming Jump, and Danger Intuition.
items.downside: Weak bad luck and risk of losing identity.

items.name: Fortune Accessory
items.function: Increases the owner's luck.

items.name: Groselle's Travels
items.appearance: Ordinary-looking book with a brown goatskin cover.
items.function: Collecting information from the recreated subconscious of those who had died under the influences of the book.
items.downside: Those who had a long contact, or had their blood dropped into this book, would inevitably be transported into the minor world inside the book.

items.name: Harvest Sacrifice
items.function: Inflicts wounds that drain the target's life force when tainted with corresponding blood.

items.name: Ice Amulet
items.function: Allows seven traversals through the Mirror World or fourteen transmissions of information.

items.name: Klein's Gold Coins
items.function:
1. They are mediums which allow the user to participate in The Fool's Dream.
2. They can enhance one's divination accuracy and the ability to resist outside interference.

items.name: Klein's Iron Cigar Case
items.appearance: An iron cigar case with signs of corrosion.
items.function:
*Carries the aura of The Fool.
*Resistant to corrosion.

items.name: Lilith's Ring
items.appearance: A red ring with a blood-colored gem.
items.function:
1. Make the wearer more charming.
2. Simulates a "silver" full moon.
3. Summons spirit world creatures as strong as the user for around 5 minutes.
items.downside: The user must drink a bottle of human blood every hour or else his blood will boil and death will occur in 15 minutes.

items.name: Mechanical Music Box
items.function: The potential to either kill or drive anyone who hears its music into madness.
items.downside: The owner must hear it for at least ten seconds.

items.name: Mirror World Fragments
items.appearance: A mirror fragment with a black, nearly lightless surface.
items.function: Ability to create Mirror People.

items.name: Moon Paper Figurine
items.function: Can replace user against fatal injury or direct attack against the Soul Body.
items.downside: Make's the user feel slightly cold

items.name: Moon Puppet
items.appearance: A slender puppet embedded with dried grass and flowers.

items.name: Mutated Paper Figurine
items.function: It has the remnant aura of the Artificial Death.

items.name: Painting Album
items.function: The objects drawn on it might become alive and stay so for a short period of time.
items.downside: Never to respond to the knocks coming from the painting paper.

items.name: Persona Masks
items.function:
1. Each mask can amplify the knowledge and emotions corresponding to its sin to help the wearer realize their own problems.
2. Allows the wearer to enter the Garden of Eden.
items.downside: They will also bring some negative effects, and unknowingly change the wearer's personality.

items.name: Proliferation Necklace
items.appearance: A necklace with black miniature rhinoceros horn
items.function: Charms a person
items.downside: It would corrupt both the user and the one it was used on

items.name: Ring of the Sea Queen
items.function: A high-level Steal ability usable only once.
items.downside: The ancient Angel Amon will take notice of you.

items.name: Sanguine Anesthesia Gas
items.function: Cause deep slumber that lasts for more than three hours.

items.name: Seven-Stone Bracelet
items.appearance: A bracelet with three diamonds flanked by four different-coloured gems.
items.function: Allows user to travel through the spirit world.
items.downside: The user will hear random sounds when wearing it.

items.name: Shadow Cloak
items.function: Allows user to blend into shadows.

items.name: The Magician's Traveler's Bag
items.function:
1. It conceals another dimension within and can accommodate a vast array of items.
2. While within the bag, Beyonder characteristics do not require regular relocation, and the negative effects of mystical items will significantly diminish.
items.downside: It needs resealing and reinforcement every six months; otherwise, it will lose its mystical abilities and become ordinary.

items.name: Traveler Bracelet
items.function: Allows user to travel through the spirit world
items.downside: The user will hear strange, faint murmurings during the full moon or blood moon

items.name: White Primordial Demoness Figurine
items.appearance: A pure white, palm-sized bone figurine of a beautiful woman with snake-like hair.
items.function:
1. Possessing anti-divination and early warning abilities, it can also assist in performing rituals.
2. It is able to suppress non-conscious diseases, shielding the user from them.

items.name: Amantha extract
items.function: An aromatic floral essence. Daly call it 'Amantha;' it means tranquility in the Hermes language. There is a quiet and charming fragrance, which can relax people's emotions and instantly calm as if they was gazing into the darkness of the silent night.[10]
items.ingredients: Mixed of Night vanilla, slumber flower, and chamomile, all distilled and extracted to form this aromatic floral essence.[10]

items.name: Bark Agent
items.function: It toughens the user skin and muscles, rendering them as resilient as trees.[22]

items.name: Berserk Agent
items.function: It grants the user extraordinary strength when unleashed.[22]

items.name: Eye of the Spirit medication
items.function: There is an ethereal scent of the aromatic wine, which is a good helper for psychics and a charming enough flower essence.[10]
items.ingredients: Barks and leaves of drago and poplar trees are sun-dried for seven days and decocted thrice. Then immersed them in Lanti Wine.[10]

items.name: Goddess's Gaze
items.function: A dark red liquid. It has a certain therapeutic effect, and its main function is to stimulate the spirit and squeeze the potential of the body, so that people can maintain a good state in a short period of time and support them until they return to receive treatment.[11]

items.name: Healing Agent
items.function: It mends most external wounds, alleviates severe injuries, and eliminates minor ailments.[22]

items.name: Holy Night Powder
items.function: Originated from the Church of the Evernight Goddess. It can assist Beyonder to guide their own power before ritual magic, create a wall of spirituality, and build a clean and undisturbed spiritual environment around them.[14] The limit is up to obtaining a personal silver knife or reaching Sequence 7.[13]
items.ingredients: Slumber flowers, Dragon Blood grass, deep red sandalwood, mint powder, and other herbs.[12][13]

items.name: Mysticism Smelling Salts (Awakening Gas)
items.function: An extremely foul-smelling gas that wakes the smeller up. It can be use to cancel or protect from the sleeping gas.[18] It was named "Mysticism Smelling Salts" by Franca.[20]

items.name: Quelaag's Oil
items.function: It could help a person ignore the stench of rotting corpses, as well as refresh and clear the mind.[15]
items.ingredients: A mix of mint and disinfectant

items.name: Sanguine Anesthesia Gas
items.function: Cause deep slumber that lasts for more than three hours.[19]

items.name: Sedative Agent
items.function: A blue fluid rippled in the translucent glass bottle. It made users stay awake and feel as though they had entered a mother's embrace. It was a liquid medicine that was rarely used yet was very efficient in mediumship.[16][17]

items.name: Serenity Agent
items.function: Its made users maintaining clam and rationale.[18]

items.name: Truth Serum (Confession Concoction)
items.function: A serum that make exceedingly challenging to lie. What the victims utter should stem from their innermost desires.[21]

items.name: Eye of Crystal
items.function: Allow the wearer to see the spiritual body directly, as well as ghosts and shadows.
items.downside:
Attract monsters like wraiths and shadows to the vicinity.
If it was worn for a long time, one's vision would suffer irreversible damage.

items.name: Mutated Sun Sacred Emblem
items.appearance: A badge with a dark gold luster, engraved with the signs of the Sun.
items.function: Purifies sentient beings in a fifteen-meter radius.
items.downside: It turns the user into a Sun-worshipping idiot if used for too long.

items.name: Misfortune Cloth Puppet
items.appearance: A cloth puppet wearing a regal gown.
items.function: It brings misfortune to people nearby, although they have to be near it for a sufficiently long period of time for it to work.
items.downside: Affects the user as well.

items.name: Peaceful Hair Strands
items.appearance: A simple decoration formed with many strands of black hair.
items.function: Any living creature that came into contact with this artifact would turn peaceful and lose all motivation.
items.downside: Affects the user as well.

items.name: Spirit Medium's Mirror
items.appearance: A mirror, its back is plated in mercury, the front has three minor cracks.
items.function: Whoever looks into it encounters danger.
items.downside: Affects the user as well.

items.name: Mystery Prying Glasses
items.appearance: A pair of gold-rimmed glasses with a tea-colored tint.
items.function:
1. Allows the wearer to perceive invisible truths.
2. The wearer can draw paintings with various effects.
3. The wearer can use cosmetic to achieve an excellent disguise.
items.downside:
1. Seeing what should remain unseen without adequate protection exposes to unknown dangers.
2. The wearer will be seized by an uncontrollable urge to paint.
3. If someone looks too often at his own face while in disguise, he'll be convinced that his disguise is his real face.

items.name: Flare
items.function:
1. It grants additional buffs such as courage and strength through singing.
2. It enables the user to sense the presence of undead creatures and evil entities.
3. It allow him to employ spells and rituals from the Sun domain, making it highly effective against undead souls and similar targets.
items.downside:
1. After wearing it, you'll feel compelled to sing. Darkness and cold become unbearable, and you'll yearn for sunlight and warmth.
2. If you haven't removed it after half an hour, you'll become a devoted follower of the Eternal Blazing Sun.

items.name: Master Key
items.function: Lets the user pass through walls and open any lock that is not protected by mystical powers.
items.downside:
* Makes the user lost.
* At the full moon, the holder will hear the scream of Mr. Door.

items.name: Circus
items.function:
It can conjure a gust of wind, create fog, and use bursts of light to mess with the target's vision. By touching them, the wearer can freeze enemies.
It allows the wearer to open most doors without a key and to pass through solid walls.
items.downside: By wearing it, the user gets lost more often. And sometimes, getting lost brings misfortune.

items.name: Green Essence
items.appearance: A golden ring with inlaid emerald.
items.function: It treats minor diseases and wounds.
items.downside: It attracts mosquitoes.

items.name: Broken Finger
items.appearance: A grayish white tweezers inlaid with two finger bones.
items.function: Makes the user better at stealing items.
items.downside: The user is affected by kleptomania when worn.

items.name: Murloc Cufflink
items.function: Breathe underwater, increased mobility underwater.
items.downside: The user becomes more tired in hot or dry places.

items.name: Alcohol Nemesis
items.function:
Help the user to maintain energy and lucidity in his thoughts.
Improve user ability to resist spell that affects the Body of Heart and Mind.
items.downside: It will continuously damage the liver and brain. Wearing it too long, and the user would lose thoughts and logic.

items.name: Eye of Truth
items.appearance: A peculiar monocle seemingly fashioned from flesh and blood.
items.function: It has the ability to see through illusions, perceive the truth, and discern the light of spirituality.
items.downside:
*If it is worn, the user can hear the voice of some hidden entity at any moment and experience an irresistible negative influence.
*If it is only carried and not in contact with the body, the user will only experience faint tinnitus and auditory hallucinations.

items.name: Harris Rapier
items.function: Absolute Destruction

items.name: Dream of Eternity
items.function: Can pull multiple people into the same dream.
items.downside: Using it at its maximum range leaves the user with strong mental trauma.

items.name: Pride Armor
items.function: Grants the user abilities of a Dawn Paladin
items.downside:
1. Wearer hold disdain for those standing behind them and targets concealed in the darkness or invisible. They may attack them.
2. It indiscriminately eliminates weak humans within a 50-meter radius. Should the wearer weaken, they too become a target.
3. The wearer of the armor eventually experiences varying degrees of betrayal, irrespective of whether they still wear the item.
4. The wearer is vulnerable to its attacks when using other mystical items.

items.name: Tanago Scarecrow
items.appearance: A scarecrow, parts of it were made of brownish-green straw, but its arms, chest, and thighs were covered in real skin.
items.function: Erases people within 30-meter radius.
items.downside: Affects the user as well.

items.appearance: A golden box engraved with symbols and magic labels.
items.function: Maintains the internal temperature inside the box.
items.downside:
1. Long contact turns the person into Eternal Blazing Sun believer.
2. Objects placed inside will develop sentience.

items.name: Blood Vessel Thief
items.function: Can steal abilities and let the user use them for 10 minutes, the stolen would need a few days to recover it.
items.downside: Drains the user's lifespan.

items.appearance: A ring inlaid with many tiny diamonds.
items.function: Imitates Beyonder abilities the user has seen, identifies abilities and items.
items.downside: Overworks the user's brain, leading to retardation if used for too long.

items.name: Door of Death
items.appearance: Normally a normal wooden door. It can disguise itself into pre-existing doors.
items.function: Kills whoever walks through.
items.downside: Tries to escape and disguise itself as a normal door.

items.name: Antigonus Family Puppet
items.appearance: A puppet covered in an oil-stained brown cloth, its face is painted like a clown in red and yellow.
items.function: Slows people nearby down, physically and mentally.
items.downside: Affects everybody, including the user.

items.name: Inexhaustible Poison
items.appearance: A silver cup filled with a crystal-clear liquid.
items.function: Tempts and kills the drinker.
items.downside: Affects everyone around it including the user.

items.name: Wintry Blade
items.appearance: A transparent, nearly invisible triangular blade.
items.function: Freezes the body and thoughts of those pierced by it. Turns thoughts and movements of enemies sluggish and rigid.
items.downside: Slowly losing body temperature. Once the limit is exceeded (3 or 4 hours), the holder turn into an undead.

items.name: Word of the Sea
items.function: The holder can use lightning, wind, water, acid rain, underwater breathing, and flight.
items.downside: Sings dangerous songs, living artifact that attacks the user, and attracts lightning.

items.name: Gargoyle Glasses
items.function: Making people turn numb.
items.downside: The user loses agility, user can become numb if used in front of the mirror.

items.name: Hand of Horror
items.appearance: A long black glove made of gauze.
items.function:
1. Charm Bribe: By giving the target an item, the target will have positive emotions toward the user.
2. Distortion: By twisting the words, actions, and intentions of their target, they can produce "order."
3. Confusion: They can make the target or a specific location "confused."
4. Majesty: They can display a sense of great majesty, causing others to want to lower their bodies and obey them.
items.downside:
The user becomes dishonest and corrupt.
The user becomes confused when he worn it for too long.

items.name: Flower of Blood
items.appearance: A gold ring with an inlaid ruby.
items.function: It gives the user flesh and blood magic, including regeneration.
items.downside: The user randomly loses thinking and reasoning ability.
items.status: Lost during the George III's Apotheosis Ritual

items.name: Thunder God's Roar
items.appearance: A heavy, dark blue hammer, surrounded by silvery electric light. Its handle resembles the leg bone of a creature.
items.function: It can produce sounds that left the enemy in fear and chaos, and destructive lightning when used.
items.downside: Increases the probability of being attacked in the dark to 100%, the holder becomes irritated more easily.

items.name: Scales of Luck
items.appearance: A silver necklace, it has an ancient coin as a pendant with words carved in ancient Hermes: "You will be as unlucky as you are lucky now."
items.function:
1. Make the wearer lucky: in daily life, the user will encounter good things from time to time.
2. In the event of great peril, the wearer becomes absurdly lucky for ten minutes.
3. The wearer can actively give the enemy bad luck.
items.downside: After having been lucky, the user become likewise unlucky. The luck gained in the battle will be reversed in the same fierce way after ten minutes.

items.name: Death Knell
items.function:
1. Finds and aim precisely the target's weakness.
2. Increase damages.
3. Shotgun effect.
items.downside:
Gives the user a random phobia for 6 hours.
The user will also be continuously thirsty.

items.name: Leymano's Travels
items.appearance: A palm-sized notebook with a hard copper-green outer casing.
items.function: Copies Beyonder abilities it has seen, allowing them to be reused only once.
items.downside: Makes the user lost. This can be avoided by smearing his blood on its cover.

items.name: Tinder
items.appearance: A glove that can change its color.
items.function:
1. Enhance the user's charm, making his words very convincing.
2. Can steal a target's ability and allow the wearer to use it for 10 minutes. The stolen would need at least 12 hours to recover it.
items.downside:
1. Before he can steal someone's ability, the wearer need to let the glove take one of his own power for 12 hours, in exchange he would be allowed to use steal as many time he wants for 12 hours.
2. The wearer is more likely to lose his carried items.

items.name: Whip of Mind
items.appearance: A black iron ring with a spiked bulge stained with blood at the top.
items.function:
Cause mental damage to the target.
The wearer becomes more proficient with various weapons.
items.downside: Gives the user headaches.

items.name: Lie
items.appearance: Normally a silver half-mask, but it can change its appearance.
items.function: Appearance Morphing, Flame Controlling, Damage Transfer, Improved balance and agility, Danger intuition.
items.downside: The user's emotions will be amplified.

items.name: Gold Mask
items.appearance: A golden mask with rough facial features.
items.function: Enhanced physical abilities, curse, and black magic.
items.downside: Lose your humanity the more you use it.

items.name: Scarlet Lunar Corona
items.function: Make the user immune to the influence of the full moon. Simulates the full moon, gives user great speed, rejuvenation, and darkness spells.
items.downside: The user's blood slowly freezes as long as he keeps it active. If he doesn't stop, or drink the blood of a living person, he will ultimately die.

items.name: Shapeshifting Hat
items.appearance: A hat that can change its shapes.
items.function: Wearing it allows to move freely underwater for 30 minutes and use some Water and Wind domain spells.
items.downside: You will desire water; on land you will gradually weaken.

items.name: Sun Brooch
items.function: Gives access to Sun Pathway spells
items.downside: Makes the user feel very hot

items.name: Creeping Hunger
items.function:
1. Can use the stored souls' Beyonder abilities.
2. Allows the user to hide in shadows.
3. Turn bodies into flesh bombs.
items.downside:
Consumes a human's soul and flesh for each twenty-four-hour period it is used.
It will praise the True Creator from time to time.

items.name: Biological Poison Bottle
items.function: Produces a variety of random poisonous fumes.
items.downside: Affects the user as well.

items.name: Traveler Robe
items.appearance: A classical black robe with a door-shaped symbol formed with three rubies, three emeralds, and three diamonds.
items.function: Allows the user to teleport.
items.downside: It gradually tightened the user's body after each uses.

items.name: Boxing Glove
items.function: Similar to Sequence 5 Guardian.
items.downside: The user becomes more rash and often acts without thinking.

items.name: All-Black Eye
items.function: User can see Spirit Body Threads, which can be used to find the hidden target.
items.downside: User will hears a illusory raving. Can mutate nearby creatures that have been contaminated by the True Creator.

items.name: Mental Terror Candle
items.appearance: A short candle with a black wick. It is wrapped in a layer of something that looks like human skin.
items.function: Entering the deepest part of the target's soul. There, the user would be able to resolve psychological issues, or plant a cue.
items.downside: After using it for five minutes, the user will completely lose consciousness, and his mind will never be able to return to his body.

items.name: Judge Button
items.function: Corresponding Sequence 6 Judge of the Justiciar Pathway.
items.downside: Wearer easily offends people or monsters.

items.name: Notary Certificate
items.appearance: An orange paper with symbols corresponding to the sun on it.
items.function: Can enforce contracts after somebody presses his palm against the blank area and makes an oath.
items.downside: The person who made the oath have to respect it or pay the price.

items.name: Sleep Bugle
items.function: When blown, it produces a melody with the power to cause calmness.
items.downside: Unknown

items.name: Clown Mask
items.appearance: A thin and soft leather clown mask

items.name: Lifeblood
items.appearance: An injector made of rubber hoses, a glass syringe, and a thin needle
items.function: Once injected into the user body, it allows them to control their flesh and blood completely for a short period.
items.downside: With each injection, the user will become closer to the True Creator.

items.name: Decency
items.appearance: A golden brooch carved into a Scotch Broom

items.name: Cardi's Ring
items.appearance: An iron-black ring engraved with dark and complicated patterns.
items.function: Psychologically shock the target or cause the target to lose his reasoning.
items.downside: The user develops a split personality.

items.name: Integrity Brooch
items.function: Can create Holy sunlight and ignite materials to deal with ghost-type creatures.
items.downside:
Wearing it for too long will cause the wielder to become fanatical.
As long someone wear it, he will lose some thoughts.

items.name: Needle and Tube
items.appearance: A combination of a needle, a tube, and a container with mysterious patterns.
items.function: Can draw blood of the user, then transfuse it back later for healing and increased physical attributes.
items.downside:
1. Drawing blood weakens the user for 12 hours.
2. Using it too often will weaken the user permanently.
3. If someone carry it around for more than half an hour, he'll become a little neurotic.

items.name: Flog
items.function:
*It induces a surge of desire or emotion of the target. The user can predict and influence the target's reaction, with a success rate of 70-80%.
*It possesses unparalleled sturdiness, capable of withstanding an assault from a Reaper without sustaining damage.
items.downside:
*Carrying the boxing glove will have a negative impact on one's self-control.
*Wearing the boxing glove will draw the attention of a hidden entity.

items.name: Shadow Bracelet
items.function:
1. The user can conceal himself within larger shadows.
2. It can summon a Shadow Servant with a few special abilities and can bring shadows to life to restrain targets to some extent.

items.name: Ring of Punishment
items.appearance: An iron-colored ring with a thick band and slender spikes on its surface.
items.function: It can pierce a target's Spirit Body within a five-meter range, causing excruciating pain and rendering them temporarily unconscious.
items.downside:
1. Wearing it for an extended period will make the user, bloodthirsty, cruel, and impulsive.
2. If used more than three times in an hour, it will cause the wearer's personality to undergo mutation.
3. If removed, the user will suffer indiscriminate Psychic Piercing damage once he enters in a five-meter radius.

items.name: Blade of Poison
items.function: Randomly poisons target on hit.
items.downside: Medicine becomes ineffective on user, feeling of drunkenness.

items.name: Fury of the Sea
items.function: Underwater mobility and electric shock attack
items.downside: Heightened likelihood of being struck by lightning on rainy days, coupled with increased irritability and anxiety after wearing it.

items.name: Blood Gold
items.appearance: A golden ring that bears an engraving on its inner loop.
items.function: It gives the user the ability to control their flesh and blood and some flesh and blood magic.
items.downside: Repeated use may lead to dependence. Ceasing to wear it results in the body collapsing into a pile of flesh and blood, unable to maintain human form. Continual wear may lead to madness and loss of control.

items.name: Devil's Whisper
items.function:
*Devil's Arm
*Malice Perception
*Desire Incarnation
*Wraith Shriek
items.downside:
*After wearing it, the user's malice will become more pronounced.
*Whether worn or not, just carrying it will cause the user's body to suffer burns from sulphur flames, both internally and externally.
*People within a hundred meters radius, including the user, will be subtly influenced by the Devil's Whisper, more prone to ill thoughts and impulsive actions.

items.name: Elf Flying Carpet
items.function: Ability to suspend and fly

items.name: Mother of Success
items.function: It allows the user to accumulate luck after each failure
items.downside: It would magnify the user shortcomings

items.name: Shermane Box
items.function: Bestows beauty and charm onto people.
items.downside: Attracts people in a way where they lose their reasoning

items.name: Rotting Meteor
items.function: It is able to launch a dark-green projectile that could instantly poison and rot the enemy's physical and spiritual body instantly. It is effective even against a Demigod.
items.downside: The holder has the probability to be watched by certain existence in The Cosmos, and unknowingly being corrupted. The user had a certain chance of sudden death or produce an anomaly.

items.name: Concerto of Light and Shadow
items.appearance: An iron-skinned pocket watch, half of the watch's face is filled with neatly arranged symbols, while the other half is chaotic.
items.function:
1. It can restrict certain actions in the area, and strip certain Beyonder powers from the target.
2. It can also gift certain negative effects to the target, making him sluggish; eager; avaricious; or lose their fighting spirit.
3. It could distort the target's speech, actions, intentions, and attacks, reducing a lethal blow into a serious injury, or it could repel an attack, turning progression into retrogression, escaping into leading a charge.
items.downside: When the user enter combat state, random change that affects Beyonder abilities will uncontrollably occur within its range.

items.name: Antigonus Family's Notebook
items.function: Contains the legacy of the Antigonus family.
items.downside: Secretly corrupts the person who flips through its content.

items.name: Golden Sundial
items.function: Manifesting the sun, directing all the light and heat to the desired target.
items.downside: Unknown

items.name: Arrodes
items.appearance: A silver mirror with ancient patterns on the back and an eye-like pattern on each side at the front.
items.function: Powerful divination capabilities.
items.downside: Forces user to answer embarrassing questions or receive a punishment. Must be used in the presence of others.

items.name: Ullamos Statue
items.appearance: A milky-white stone statue half the height of a person. It portrayed a beautiful half-naked woman, her dress torn away to the waist.
items.function: It would entice nearby creatures to obsess over it, spreading various illnesses, some common and others mystical in nature.
items.downside: It would transform its surroundings into a nightmarish landscape of agony — living beings wailing, writhing, and perishing in horrifying ways.

items.function: Unknown
items.downside: Shifting target (either physical body or mind) into a dream between reality and illusion.

items.function: Everything that is reflected will become a mirror world that only targets Beyonders.
items.downside: Unknown

items.name: Berserker's Armor
items.appearance: A silver full-body armor with dark-red bloodstains.
items.function: Gives user great strength, defense and tracking ability.
items.downside: The user cannot use for too long without being infected with a sort of icy silver.

items.function: When used, it can erase the selected memories from the target.
items.downside: Can turn user and target into an amnesiac (uncontrollable).

items.appearance: A young woman wearing a nun's attire.
items.function:
* Manipulator
  * Power of "Speech".
* Heavybringer
items.downside: Sometimes enters a state of madness during which surrounding people get infected with "Derangement".

items.name: Fallen Flute
items.function:
Once the wielder blows it, the living around it will fall into an unavoidable illusion as their emotions and desires would rapidly swell.
The wielder will be extremely sensitive to danger and sometimes can even predict a threat to its life one to two days earlier.
items.downside:
Wherever this artifact is, one's humanity will gradually degenerate.
The user would become colder, the longer used the deeper it becomes.

items.name: Life's Cane
items.function: Controls spiritual creatures, mutates other creatures, create artificial golems and humans, powerful healing abilities.
items.downside: The user would have a high chance of mutation. The longer they hold the cane, the higher the chance. This will result in additional organs, or even having body parts being replaced by various plants.

items.name: Twilight Mask
items.function: Death by eye contact, powerful death attack, high resistance to everything except purifying attacks, allows user to hide intentions.
items.downside: People around it will mysteriously and suddenly die unless sealed, user assaulted with powerful mental attacks, becomes the artifact's slave if worn for too long.

items.name: Sword of Silverdawn
items.appearance: A sword with a single-eyed, huge-mouthed head engraved at the tip of its hilt.
items.function: Hides wielder's intentions, show various effect when fed with corresponding ingredients, enhances defense, creates storms of dawn light.
items.downside: Requires certain height to use, living artifact that could capriciously fail or make user lose control.

items.name: Unshadowed Crucifix
items.function:
By sacrificing some blood to it, it will exude a bright light that purifies any evil influences, it will purify beyonder characteristics too.
In addition to its purifying effects, this item also has Demigod abilities in the field of 'Sun', such as "Sun Flare."
items.downside: Cannot be worn with other Beyonder item, slowly degrading user sequence if user is not an angel, will turn the user into a pious Sun believer.

items.name: Sea God Scepter
items.appearance: A short white scepter, its tip is embedded with many tiny blue gems.
items.function: Controls weather, Sea, Sea Creatures, Lightning, Wind and enchanting items.
items.downside: Makes the user angry, drains all blood in a radius periodically, receives overwhelming prayers of believers.

items.name: Vision of White
items.function:
The user can use it by looking through it to seek for a trace of evil and contaminated beings.
It can send a pure white blazing ray of light, filled with purification power to cleanse the locked target in its sight.
items.downside: The holder would feel the heat of being exposed directly to a blazing sun, unless it is sealed properly.

items.name: General of the Pupil-less Eye
items.appearance: A palm-sized exquisitely crafted male puppet and wearing a dark red gold-encrusted dress. Only two black holes left on its eye sockets.
items.function: This item could could possess a target and control every non-living thing within a certain radius according to the holder's thought.
items.downside: It has a living characteristic. User needs to feed it with their own flesh or it would grow its eyes back gradually. Once its eyes are intact and left unsealed, it will turn into an evil spirit that hate all human beings and would chase their owner crazily.

items.name: Devil's Oil Painting
items.appearance: An oil painting painted with abstract and incomprehensible contents.
items.function: It can seal and release creatures at demigod level.
items.downside: Just looking at it would make one feel dizzy and mentally weak.

items.name: Saint Selena's Ashes
items.appearance: Shining sand in an urn box.
items.function: Darkening surroundings and producing black threads to restrain people.

items.name: Sword of Courage
items.function:
*This sword fills its bearer with courage.
*It's extremely durable and sharp, capable of blocking direct attacks from demigods and significantly impacting their defences.
*It can also enable the user to perform Cull at the level of an Iron-blooded Knight.
*If the sword is coated with the target's blood or if they've been scorched by its flames, the user can throw it up to five kilometres into the sky. It will wrap itself in flames, fly toward the target and then crash down, creating a violent explosion.
items.downside:
*Excessive courage can lead to people losing their their ability to judge and analyse, leading to a swift demise.
*The user will need to prepare at least thirty ordinary broadswords to place around it. Otherwise, it will start attacking everyone nearby indiscriminately.

items.name: Black Tear
items.function:
*It continuously produces mystical pathogens that spread it around without stopping.
*It can help its wearer master some mirror magic, including passing messages through the mirror world, Mirror Traversal, and mirror illusions.
items.downside:
*The wearer also gets infected with the mystical pathogen, with Demonesses of Affliction being less affected and more resistant.
*The wearer experiences intermittent Pleasure, every 45 to 90 seconds.
*Having Black Tear increases the likelihood of unwanted romantic encounters.

items.name: Merumu's Spellbook
items.appearance: A thin book bound in human skin, with many mysterious patterns and symbols on the cover.

items.name: Eye of Omniscience
items.appearance: A transparent, pure gemstone eye, with different brilliance flashing from each facet.

items.name: Face of the Arcane
items.appearance: A mask with only the left side.

items.name: Flog
items.function:
*It induces a surge of desire or emotion of the target. The user can predict and influence the target's reaction, with a success rate of 70-80%.
*It possesses unparalleled sturdiness, capable of withstanding an assault from a Reaper without sustaining damage.
items.downside:
*Carrying the boxing glove will have a negative impact on one's self-control.
*Wearing the boxing glove will draw the attention of a hidden entity.

items.name: Bottle of Slavery
items.appearance: A transparent glass bottle stained with a dark colour.
items.function: Able to grant wish of its holder.
items.downside: Will try to trick people into becoming its slaves.

items.name: Remains of a Deformed Person
items.function: Unknown
items.downside: Unknown

items.name: Staff of the Stars
items.appearance: A black cane with embedded gems.
items.function:
1. While holding the staff, using corresponding scenes in your mind, holder will directly descend to their desired destination. The prerequisite was that the outlined scene had to be absolutely correct.
2. While holding the Staff, if some Beyonder powers or figures appear in your mind, this cane will reenact the corresponding powers and person.
3. Any foes struck by it will randomly mutate or encounter various strange effects.
items.downside: If the staff is left unsealed with no one holding it, various anomalies would appear around it unpredictably.

items.name: Box of the Great Old Ones
items.function:
1. The first layer of the box can turn everything in a targeted place into toys and swap it with its own internal space.
2. The second layer recorded different locations. Once it was released, the holder and the living beings within its effective range would randomly head directly to the corresponding region. Depending on their luck, they could end up in places like the Abyss or the Cosmos.
3. The third layer of the box seals something extremely powerful, horrible, and dangerous.
items.downside: The holder of the box will disappear randomly, die, or change to a new holder.

items.name: The Divine Kingdom Without People
items.function: Turn living beings into undead

items.name: Thorned Crown
items.function: Similar to Sequence 2, Lightseeker.
items.downside: Needs to be supplied with blood to activate its power.

items.name: Theater With Curtains That Never Draw
items.function: Similar to Sequence 2, Miracle Invoker.

items.name: Angel of Concealment
items.appearance: An expressionless woman with black eyes.
items.function:
* Erases people.
* Descent vessel of the Darkness Pathway Deity.
items.downside: Cannot be controlled. The range of abilities randomly fluctuates.

items.name: The Last Banquet
items.function: Based on a Sequence 2 Miracle Invoker.

items.name: Quill of Alzuhod
items.function:
1. Can make what it writes happen if it is possible and without the participants knowing, except if they notice the coincidences.
2. The more you know about 0-08, the more it knows about you and everyone around you.
items.downside: Tries to kill user, causes a backlash when used.

items.name: Magic Wishing Lamp
items.appearance: A golden lamp covered with mysterious and complicated symbols
items.function: Able to grant up to 10 wishes of its holder.
items.downside: The granted wish would always come in a distorted and horrible manner and accompanied with terrible consequences. The holder can avoid the harm brought by the first two wishes, through proper wording and preparations, but the third wish will have terrible consequences.

items.name: Trunsoest Brass Book
items.appearance: A book bound by thin brass sheets.
items.function: Introducing laws, offenders of the law will automatically be punished accordingly or the action itself will become impossible to do.
items.downside: It cumulatively writes new laws, eventually creating a system wherein one would be punished regardless of what they do, that includes the user himself, unless he could negotiate immunity with it.

items.name: Salinger's Blood Banner
items.appearance: A charred banner. The flagpole is iron-black metal, and there are a large number of dangerous blood spots on the banner.

items.name: Scroll of God
items.appearance: An ordinary oil painting in a brass frame, but the content depicted inside will change from time to time.
items.function: There are various effect corresponding to each scene depicted by the painting.
items.downside: If the oil painting is left unattended and unappreciated, the characters in it will come alive, comes out from the oil painting, and enter the real world.

items.name: Gift of the Land
items.function: Various High-Sequence abilities of the Mother Pathway.
items.downside:
1. User has high chance of death if certain conditions are not met.
2. Dying people within a 50km vicinity will turn into an Evil Spirit unless killed by a family member or if they can leave the range of the artifact.
3. Will randomly cause the land within a 300-kilometer range to become desolate.

items.name: Pale Death
items.appearance: A pale mask with glittering metallic lustre.
items.function: The wearer's surroundings "die", even lifeless objects.
items.downside: Slowly turns the user into an undead and enslaves them.

items.name: Sage Frontlet
items.appearance: A frontlet with a vertical diamond eye in the centre.
items.function: Allows the wearer to turn into an immaterial illusory knowledge form.
items.downside: Wearing it too long is the equivalent of taking a Sage potion. One will either successfully advance or lose control and become a monster.

items.name: Proof of Glory
items.appearance: A crown that seemed to coalesce from dawn's light. Its ancient design exuded splendor, majesty, pride, and resilience.
items.function: Create defensive power in form of a cage.

items.name: Shadow of the Beauty Goddess
items.appearance: A blurry figure formed from crimson moonlight.

items.name: Black Emperor's Crown
items.appearance: A crown inlaid with many dark gems

items.name: Destined Madness
items.function: (Unknown)
items.downside: (Unknown)

items.name: Solomon's Mask
items.appearance: An asymmetrical black and gold mask.

items.name: Post-Apocalyptic Scripture
items.appearance: An ancient book made of sheepskin parchment.

items.name: Love's Dread
items.appearance: A glass ring with an extending sharp crystalline spike.

items.name: Tamara's Everchanging Card
items.appearance: A card with changing images on both sides.

items.name: Pillar of Severity
items.appearance: A blackened stone pillar with a faint bronze hue.

items.name: Robe of Divine Blood
items.function: Plant malice in others.

items.name: Die of Probability
items.appearance: An ordinary die with red pips on each of its faces.
items.function: Uncontrollably affects the luck of the user.
items.downside: Uncontrollable.

items.name: Golden Phoenix Accessory
items.function: Connect to the River of Eternal Darkness

items.name: Band of Light Ring
items.function: Can summon blinding light and use several spells in the Sun domain.
items.downside: The user will slowly become a believer of the Eternal Blazing Sun.

items.name: Building Blocks
items.appearance: A collection of brightly colored blocks.
items.function: Able to establish a connection with the real building.
items.downside: Without external help, it was almost impossible for people or items inside to leave.

items.name: Moonlight Sash
items.function: It can effectively reduce Sun and Lightning damage.
items.downside:
The user senses become more acute, able to easily see things that shouldn't be seen, hear the sounds they shouldn't hear.
The wearer will feel itchy intermittently.

items.name: Oath of Rose
items.appearance: A pair of silvery-white rings with a sapphire gem embedded in it.
items.function: Allows both wearer to share their senses and transmit their thoughts to each other.
items.downside:
It occasionally lets the user's thoughts appear in the mind of the counterpart.
If it is worn for a week without being taken off, both people who wore the ring have a great chance to fall in love, regardless of their gender and race.

items.name: Rever's Shout of Despair
items.appearance: A big gray revolver with six big barrels.
items.function:
Mental at attack every shot.
Infinite ammunition.
Machine gun mode.
items.downside: The user would also hear the shout of despair, from time to time.

items.name: Specter Portrait Frame
items.function: Seals the soul of whoever looks at it.
items.downside: Can seal the users soul if not careful.

items.name: Trumpet Telegraph
items.appearance: A golden, palm-sized telegraph with a trumpet attached to it.
items.function: It allows the user's voice to sound out simultaneously up to a radius of 5 kilometers.
items.downside: All sounds within 5 kilometers will be transmitted to the user's ears for an extended period of time.
